name: fleet
description: A fleet of executor subagents, one per model, with the reasoning effort passed as a named level on each call (none for a model without effort control), governed by a single rules file: which model may spawn which model at which effort, which skills and commands a subagent may not use, which MCP tools a subagent may call (global allow and deny lists, plus per-spawn lists in a block at the top of a fleet agent's brief), and which fleet agents and built-in models the main session may spawn. A task handed to a fleet agent must arrive as a structured brief. The start contexts of a session and of a fleet agent carry the MCP tool rules in force.
